programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton (Drama, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. - Ben Affleck, Jennifer Aniston, Drew Barrymore, Jennifer Connelly, Kevin Connolly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore, Tony Danza, Glenne Headley (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Young Adult

However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school. - Charlize Theron, Patton Oswalt, Patrick Wilson, Elizabeth Reaser, Jill Eikenberry (Comedy drama, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Anything Else

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync. - Rachel McAdams, Eric Bana, Arliss Howard, Ron Livingston, Stephen Tobolowsky (Romance, Drama, Science fiction)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley, Dan Gill, Ivy George (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: Candy (Charlize Theron) and Lonnie Earl (Billy Bob Thornton) are just crazy about each other. The problem: she's married to Roy (Patrick Swayze) and he's married to Darlene (Natasha Richardson). So far it's been a secret affair. But that's about to change, because this foursome is driving cross-country and headed for some big surprises. - Billy Bob Thornton, Charlize Theron, Natasha Richardson, Patrick Swayze, Holmes Osborne (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. - Robert De Niro, Edward Norton, Angela Bassett, Marlon Brando, Gary Farmer (Thriller, Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. - Jason Statham, Ben Foster, Donald Sutherland, Tony Goldwyn, Jeff Chase (Action, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian). - Christian Bale, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, John Sharian, Michael Ironside (Thriller)

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: Law student Martin Bells (Ewan McGregor) needs to make some money, and so he takes a side job as a night watchman in a morgue. He thinks he'll have time to study, but with a serial killer on the loose -- one with a propensity for necrophilia -- he has to be more alert than ever. While at work, Martin starts putting together the clues and realizes that the police, including Inspector Thomas Cray (Nick Nolte), have good reason to make him their prime suspect. - Ewan McGregor, Nick Nolte, Josh Brolin, Patricia Arquette, Alix Koromzay (Horror, Drama)

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - André Holland, Kate Mara, Zazie Beetz, Stephen McKinley Henderson, Aldis Hodge (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. - John Doman (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain. - Seth Green, Matthew Lillard, Dax Shepard, Ethan Suplee, Abraham Benrubi (Comedy, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Without a Paddle: Nature's Calling
programme.desc: Two friends (Oliver James, Kristopher Turner) and a crazy Briton (Rik Young) have wild misadventures while searching for a missing girl in the woods. - Oliver James, Kristopher Turner, Rik Young, Amber McDonald, Madison Riley (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. - Amanda Plummer, Ulrich Thomsen, Costas Mandylor, James Russo, Barkhad Abdi (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: In the 25th century, the Earth's population has dwindled to a surviving five million following a devastating virus that almost resulted in the extinction of all human life 400 years earlier. Confined to one city-state, a group of rebels, led by Handler (Frances McDormand), seeks to destroy the oppressive government -- first, by assassinating a high-ranking chairman (Marton Csokas). Tasked with this mission, Aeon Flux (Charlize Theron) must integrate herself in a world of deceit and mystery. - Charlize Theron, Marton Csokas, Jonny Lee Miller, Sophie Okonedo, Frances McDormand (Science fiction, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: An acting CIA chief (Harrison Ford) learns the president has triggered a war with Colombian drug cartels.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: A publicity-seeking Chicago lawyer (Richard Gere) vies with an embittered ex-lover (Laura Linney) prosecuting an altar boy (Edward Norton) in a high-profile murder case.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: A 22-year-old clerk (Brian O'Halloran) takes in a day's worth of customers at a convenience store in New Jersey.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: Three childhood friends (Seth Green, Matthew Lillard, Dax Shepard) embark on a canoe trip to find a plane hijacker's stash of money.

programme.title: The Argument
programme.desc: When a couple argue about a party and neither will back down, they decide to re-create the evening to determine who is right.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Col. Mustard, Miss Scarlet, Mrs. Peacock, and company solve a mansion murder based on the board game.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer (Tom Cruise) has trouble distinguishing dreams from reality after a car accident leaves him disfigured.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.

programme.title: The Kings of Summer
programme.desc: Three teenagers (Nick Robinson, Gabriel Basso, Moises Arias) carry out a plan to leave their dysfunctional parents, build a house in the woods and live off the land.

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: To impress a young woman (Tara Reid), a man (Ashton Kutcher) agrees to house-sit at his employer's mansion for one night.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: David (Woody Harrelson) and Diana Murphy (Demi Moore) are a loving couple with a bright future. David is a talented architect; Diana is a top-notch real estate agent. But when the recession hits, their finances take a nosedive. In a last-ditch effort to save their dream home, they head to Las Vegas to win their mortgage money gambling. After they lose everything, a mysterious billionaire (Robert Redford) offers the solution to their money problems: $1 million -- if he can sleep with Diana. - Robert Redford, Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson, Oliver Platt, Seymour Cassel (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. - Shirley Henderson, Ciarán Hinds, Allison Janney, Michael Lerner, Chris Marquette (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion. - Wesley Snipes, Ving Rhames, Peter Falk, Michael Rooker, Jon Seda (Drama, Action)

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. - Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz, Cameron Diaz, Kurt Russell, Jason Lee (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: When Johnny (Al Pacino) is released from prison following a forgery charge, he quickly lands a job as a short-order cook at a New York diner. Following a brief fling with waitress Cora (Kate Nelligan), Frankie develops an attraction for Cora's friend and fellow waitress Frankie (Michelle Pfeiffer). While Frankie resists Johnny's charms initially, she eventually relents when her best friend, Tim (Nathan Lane), persuades her to give Johnny a chance. - Al Pacino, Michelle Pfeiffer, Héctor Elizondo, Nathan Lane, Kate Nelligan (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. - Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, David Suchet, Navid Negahban (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. - Matthew Gray Gubler, AnnaLynne McCord, Alisha Boe, Sheila Vand, Sam Eidson (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Boozy writer Marty (Colin Farrell) is a man in search of a screenplay. He has a catchy title but no story to go along with it. Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However, this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay. - Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell, Woody Harrelson, Abbie Cornish (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead. - Jovan Adepo, Wyatt Russell, Pilou Asbæk, Mathilde Ollivier, John Magaro (Horror, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Monica Potter, Kevin Pollak, Tyler Lawrence Gray, Brielle Barbusca (Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose. - Eddie Murphy, Angela Bassett, Allen Payne, Kadeem Hardison, John Witherspoon (Comedy, Romance, Fantasy, Horror)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it. - Tom Cruise, Miles Teller, Jennifer Connelly, Jon Hamm, Glen Powell (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: A literature professor (Mark Wahlberg) with gambling debts borrows money from a mobster (Michael Kenneth Williams) and offers his life as collateral while immersing himself in an illicit, underground world.

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

programme.title: Machine Gun Preacher
programme.desc: Sam Childers (Gerard Butler), a former biker, travels to Africa to establish an orphanage for young victims of war.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: A married man (Billy Bob Thornton) has an affair with his best friend's wife (Charlize Theron) while both couples travel from Arkansas to Nevada.

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head travel from Las Vegas to Washington, D.C., not realizing that their landlord has sent them to kill his wife.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: In 1980 top tennis player Björn Borg is in pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship. The only obstacle in his way is the highly talented and ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalsky, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: A friend's lure of easy money draws an ex-con into the corrupt world of his uncle's subway-train business.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. In "Just Another Saturday Night," Marv (Mickey Rourke) struggles to recall a nasty run-in with some frat boys. In "A Dame to Kill For," Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) forsakes his battle with his inner demons to help Ava Lord (Eva Green), the woman of his dreams and nightmares. In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge. - Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Josh Brolin, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Rosario Dawson (Action, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Heather Graham (Comedy)

programme.title: Buddymoon
programme.desc: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon. - David Giuntoli, Flula Borg, Claire Coffee, Brian T. Finney, Jeanne Syquia (Comedy)

programme.title: Staten Island Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Frank work as lifeguards for the summer and make plans to throw the wildest party of the season. - Ashley Greene, Kate Walsh, Gina Gershon, Jim Gaffigan, Graham Phillips (Comedy)

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. - Robert De Niro, Edward Norton, Angela Bassett, Marlon Brando, Gary Farmer (Thriller, Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: Citizen Bio
programme.desc: Exploring in depth the nascent biohacking movement and the unconventional scientists and researchers developing alternative medicines to prolong human life and eradicate incurable viruses and diseases. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: The Honey Trap: A True Story of Love, Lies and the FBI
programme.desc: The story of Denis Cuspert, aka Deso Dogg, and his journey from infamous German rapper to ISIS recruiter; exploring the circular relationship between propaganda, recruitment and the soft power of entertainment culture. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.desc: Secret agent James T. West (Will Smith) and his partner (Kevin Kline) fight evil inventor Dr. Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) who plans to assassinate President Grant. - Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Get Hard
programme.desc: The prison-bound manager of a hedge fund asks a Black businessman, who has never been to jail, to prepare him for life behind bars. - Will Ferrell, Kevin Hart, Craig T. Nelson (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: Phil, Stu and Doug take Alan on a road trip to help him through a personal crisis. Mr. Chow breaks out of prison and prepares to wreak havoc. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: A square British exchange student (Maxwell Caulfield) turns hip motorcyclist to woo a cool girl (Michelle Pfeiffer) in his 1961 high school. - Maxwell Caulfield, Michelle Pfeiffer, Pamela Adlon (Movies, Musical)

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: SpongeBob (Tom Kenny) and Patrick (Bill Fagerbakke) head for Shell City to retrieve King Neptune's stolen crown and save the life of Mr. Krabs (Clancy Brown). - Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke, Clancy Brown (Movies, Animated)

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Perpetual adversaries SpongeBob and Plankton join forces and come ashore to battle a pirate who has plans for the stolen Krabby Patties recipe. - Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke, Rodger Bumpass (Movies, Children)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource. - Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James (Movies, Action)

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows. - Daniel Day-Lewis, Paul Dano, Kevin J. O'Connor (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner (Jason Bateman) of a flavor-extract factory suffers a series of personal and professional disasters following a freak workplace accident. - Jason Bateman, Mila Kunis, Kristen Wiig (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past. - Naomi Watts, Bill Murray, Ann Dowd (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Here and Now
programme.desc: After receiving a grim diagnosis, a successful New York singer spends the day reflecting on her life. She crisscrosses the city as she attempts to make peace with her friends, family and failures. - Sarah Jessica Parker, Renée Zellweger, Taylor Kinney (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: A New Jersey bartender (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) embarks on his first genuine relationship with a woman (Scarlett Johansson), but his constant craving for Internet porn threatens to bring things crashing down. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Teenagers and their parents try to navigate the many ways the internet has changed their relationships, communication and self-image. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs (Movies, Action)

programme.title: The Words
programme.desc: An aspiring writer pays a heavy price after he finds another man's long-lost manuscript and passes it off as his own. - Bradley Cooper, Jeremy Irons, Dennis Quaid (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future a government agent (Christian Bale) and a band of rebels battle a regime that uses a drug to suppress people's emotions. - Christian Bale, Emily Watson, Taye Diggs (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: The fascist U.S. president enlists a jailed war hero (Kurt Russell) to retrieve a top-secret device stolen by his daughter on island Los Angeles in 2013. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: A shy boy (Rory Culkin), his older brother, and two friends (Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz) plan to take a bully on a boat trip and maroon him in the wilderness. - Rory Culkin, Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Now working as a garbage collector in the 1950s Pittsburgh, a former baseball star creates tension in his family when he squashes his son's chance to meet a college football recruiter. - Denzel Washington, Viola Davis, Stephen Henderson (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: An aging lawman (Tommy Lee Jones) reflects on his past and laments a changing world while trying to find and protect a hunter who took the cash from a drug deal gone bad. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: Organ Trail
programme.desc: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. - Zoé De Grand Maison, Nicholas Logan, Olivia Grace Applegate (Movies, Horror)

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims. - Jason Statham, Ben Foster, Donald Sutherland (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond is a New York City money launderer who wakes up with no memory and millions of dollars in stolen cash and drugs. He must soon scour the streets in search of answers while trying to dodge a crew of violent and crooked cops. - Liam Hemsworth, Emory Cohen, Diane Guerrero (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter (Colin Farrell) finds himself inadvertently entangled in the criminal underworld when his knucklehead friends (Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell) abduct a mobster's beloved Shih Tzu. - Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: Wayne and Garth battle an evil TV producer in this big-screen adaptation of the "Saturday Night Live" skit. - Mike Myers, Dana Carvey, Rob Lowe (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: The world's best roadie helps goofy Wayne (Mike Myers) and Garth (Dana Carvey) organize a rock concert called Waynestock. - Mike Myers, Dana Carvey, Christopher Walken (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. - Seth Green, Breckin Meyer, Brenda Song (Movies, Comedy/Drama)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)

The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. - John Doman (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
programme.desc: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs. - Ben Affleck, Jeff Anderson, Diedrich Bader, Eliza Dushku, Shannon Elizabeth (Comedy, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Brian Boland, Molly Ephraim, Sprague Grayden (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan. - Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric, Judi Dench, Giancarlo Giannini (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival. - Kathryn Newton, Matt Shively, Aiden Lovekamp, Brady Allen, Stephen Dunham (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1980, and Björn Borg is the top tennis player in the world, dominating the sport both on and off the court. A powerful and rigorously disciplined player, there is only one obstacle in his pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship: the highly talented but ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe. With three days until the tournament begins, Borg trains religiously in his lavish Monaco home, aided by his coach and mentor Lennart and girlfriend Mariana. - Sverrir Gudnason, Shia LaBeouf, Stellan Skarsgård, Tuva Novotny, Ian Blackman (Drama)

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. - Tim Blake Nelson, Glenn Plummer, Andrew Liner, Kevin Corrigan, Nina Arianda (Drama)

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart. - Max Eigenmann, Jaeden Boadilla, Leanne Best, David Hayman, Oliver Wellington (Horror, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. - Zoe Lister-Jones, Adam Pally, Fred Armisen, Susie Essman, Hannah Simone (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Four Letters of Love
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together. - Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter, Gabriel Byrne, Ann Skelly, Fionn O'Shea (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
programme.desc: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. - Tony Anderson, Burt Bacharach, David Foster, Sharlotte Gibson, Frances Grill (Documentary, Music)

programme.title: The Sandlot
programme.desc: When Scotty Smalls moves to a new neighborhood, he manages to make friends with a group of kids who play baseball at the sandlot. Together they go on a series of funny and touching adventures. The boys run into trouble when Smalls borrows a ball from his stepdad that gets hit over a fence. - Thomas Guiry, Mike Vitar, Patrick Renna, Chauncey Leopardi, Marty York (Children, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming. - Jenna Ortega, Percy Hynes White, Marisol Nichols, Adam Rodriguez, Elias Kacavas (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.

programme.title: Barron's Cove

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And the Last Resort (New)

programme.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And the Last Resort
programme.desc: S2E8 - The Librarians investigate a magical ley line at a 200-year-old resort known for its venerable puppet theater; their attempt to turn the mission into a vacation is thwarted when they uncover a sentient puppet's evil scheme to destroy the resort. - Callum McGowan, Olivia Morris, Bluey Robinson, Jessica Green (Drama, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno. - Dwayne Johnson, Neve Campbell, Chin Han, Roland Møller, Noah Taylor (Action, Thriller, Adventure)

programme.title: Cold Case - Triple Threat
programme.desc: S6E8 - Lilly and the team re-examine the 1989 death of a young Russian opera singer who defected to the U.S. with her family before the fall of the Berlin Wall. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Pin Up Girl
programme.desc: S6E9 - A crime scene photo provided by a fan offers new evidence in the 1953 murder of a famous pinup girl. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Street Money
